coverage_note: Coordinator reads planning and drafting artifacts in full for fixed timeline/capacity/custody/knowledge compliance. Unblinded to run IDs; this audit does not rate literary quality. Queries are not counted as definite violations.

queries.note: Key transfer, level check and recording follow the 12:05 timestamp; a stricter scene could start preparation earlier. Rounded minute notation prevents treating the implied seconds as a definite contradiction.

The planning task permits author-visible future motives but may conflict with the scene’s unresolved-motive exit; retain this as a disclosure-scope query rather than silently grading an ambiguous scope as an error.
